question: Does the exact in-population H4 program retain its task-typed causal effects and additive simultaneous composition on fully fresh temporal-v12/is-was-v16 templates and lexicons?

frozen_design.population: All 128 endpoints from the fully licensed temporal-v12/is-was-v16 OOD authority. Retain both fresh templates, both phases, all command cells, and all lexical groups without selection.
frozen_design.arms: Native, temporal-only H4 donor swap, is-was-only H4 donor swap, and both independent swaps installed together at their exact command query positions.
frozen_design.single_command_bars: In both phases, temporal signed recovery >=.80 and is-was signed recovery >=.65, cosine >=.98, direction agreement 1.0, non-target/gold norm <=.01, and is-was-to-earlier-temporal max absolute effect <=1e-5.
frozen_design.composition_bars: For every role x phase x fresh template, interaction RMS / both-effect RMS <=.10 and additive cosine >=.99. Simultaneous recovery may be at most .05 below the corresponding single-command recovery.

predictions.pred_a_authority_ood_license_pairing_fin: All hashes, all-row OOD license, pairs/positions, capture shapes, exact closure, configuration, finiteness, and price pass.
predictions.pred_b_h4_single_command_quality_and_sel: Both roles pass their frozen recovery, cosine, direction, collateral, and causal-zero bars on FIT and HOLDOUT OOD rows.
predictions.pred_c_h4_simultaneous_execution_remains: Every role x phase x fresh-template interaction and additive-cosine bar passes.
predictions.pred_d_h4_simultaneous_execution_preserv: Each role/phase simultaneous recovery is no more than .05 below its single-command OOD recovery.
predictions.pred_e_h4_ood_joint_program_is_licensed: A/B/C/D all pass without changing the head set or any bar.

null: Any B/C/D failure keeps H4 licensed only on its original population and prevents a stable OOD/composition claim. Preserve every fresh row and report template-specific failures; do not reselect heads, lower thresholds, or fit an OOD router.
decision: A/B/C/D/E promotes H4 from held-out in-population composition to fresh-template/lexicon stable identification. A pass opens selective removal and L11 value source-position localization; it still does not by itself prove standalone extraction or literal simplicity.
